ReleaseEntry.description:
One results release in the release manifest (``docs/releases.json``).

The fedcourts.ai site reads the manifest from ``main`` and each release's
documents from the release's own tag, so the list can grow while every
published page stays fixed to its tagged text. An entry whose tag does not
exist yet is shown there as upcoming.

audit.description: Repository path of the release's audit write-up, read at `tag`
audit.title: Audit

code_doi.description: The concept DOI of the project's Zenodo software record, which resolves to its newest archived version; the release cites it beside its tag, which pins the exact code. Null until the record exists
code_doi.title: Code Doi

covers.description: One line, for a lay reader, on what the release covers
covers.title: Covers

data_doi.description: The DOI of the release's Zenodo dataset record; null until reserved
data_doi.title: Data Doi

slug.description: The release's URL path segment on the site (`/results/<slug>`)
slug.title: Slug

summary.description: Repository path of the release's public summary, read at `tag`
summary.title: Summary

tag.description: The git tag the release is published from, in the `results/` namespace
tag.title: Tag

ReleaseEntry.title: ReleaseEntry

description:
``docs/releases.json`` — every results release, newest first.

Committed beside the releases it describes and promoted with them, so
publishing a release needs no change to the site that lists it.
title: ReleaseManifest
